cases.name: desktop-classic
checks: first visit muted with no AudioContext
explicit click/tap requests playback and emits nonzero audio
gesture resumes suspended context without recreating it
injected saved-on startup failure clears UI/preference/session and allows retry
mute stops output and releases session
